items.question: Up to what density altitude has R22 IGE hover controllability been substantiated, and in what wind?
options: 9800 ft (2990 m), 17 kt wind from any direction
items.explanation: IGE hover controllability has been substantiated in 17 knot wind from any direction up to 9800 feet (2990 meters) density altitude.

items.question: By how much can full carburetor heat reduce R22 hover ceilings?
options: It has no effect on hover ceiling
items.explanation: A note in Section 5: hover performance data is given with carburetor heat off; full carburetor heat reduces hover ceilings by up to 2000 feet (610 meters).

items.question: To what OAT has satisfactory R22 engine cooling been demonstrated?
options: 38°C (100°F) at sea level, or ISA + 23°C (41°F) at altitude
items.explanation: DEMONSTRATED OPERATING TEMPERATURE: satisfactory engine cooling has been demonstrated to an outside air temperature of 38°C (100°F) at sea level, or 23°C (41°F) above ISA at altitude.
references: R22 POH Sec 5: DEMONSTRATED OPERATING TEMPERATURE (p.5-1)

items.question: What does the R22 POH say about the basis of the performance charts?
options: Data was obtained under ideal conditions; performance under other conditions may be substantially less
They are conservative and can be exceeded
items.explanation: A caution: performance data presented in Section 5 was obtained under ideal conditions; performance under other conditions may be substantially less.

items.question: What is the R22 main rotor diameter?
items.explanation: Section 1 DESCRIPTIVE DATA: main rotor diameter 25 feet 2 inches, two blades, blade twist -8 degrees, tip speed at 104% RPM 698 feet per second.
references: R22 POH Sec 1: DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Main Rotor (p.1-4)

items.question: What is the R22 tail rotor diameter?
items.explanation: Section 1 DESCRIPTIVE DATA: tail rotor diameter 42 inches, two blades, constant 4-inch chord, tip speed at 104% RPM 622 feet per second.
references: R22 POH Sec 1: DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Tail Rotor (p.1-4)

items.question: The R22 tachometer displays RPM as a percentage of what reference engine and rotor speeds?
items.explanation: The Section 1 definition of RPM: shown by the tachometer as a percentage of 2550 engine RPM or 510 main rotor RPM. (So 104% corresponds to 2652 engine RPM / 530 rotor RPM.)
references: R22 POH Sec 1: PERFORMANCE DEFINITIONS – RPM (p.1-6)

items.question: In the R22 drive system, what are the speed-reducing ratios from drive line to main rotor and increasing ratio to the tail rotor?
options: 3:1 to the main rotor, 1:1 to the tail rotor
11:47 reducing to the main rotor, 3:2 increasing to the tail rotor
items.explanation: Section 1 DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Drive System: drive line to main rotor uses spiral-bevel gears with an 11:47 speed-reducing ratio; drive line to tail rotor uses spiral-bevel gears with a 3:2 speed-increasing ratio. Engine to upper sheave is via two double vee-belts with a 0.8536:1 ratio.
references: R22 POH Sec 1: DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Drive System (p.1-4)

items.question: How is KCAS defined in the R22 POH?
options: The speed shown on the airspeed indicator
Indicated airspeed corrected for instrument and position error
items.explanation: KCAS (Knots Calibrated Airspeed) is the speed shown on the airspeed indicator corrected for instrument and position error. KTAS is KCAS corrected for pressure altitude and temperature.

items.question: What is 'TOP' (Takeoff Power) in the R22 POH definitions?
options: Power available at maximum gross weight
Takeoff Power, usually limited to a maximum of 5 minutes
items.explanation: TOP is defined as Takeoff Power (usually for a maximum of 5 minutes); MCP is Maximum Continuous Power; Critical Altitude is the altitude at which full throttle produces maximum allowable power (MCP or TOP).

items.question: The R22 Beta II O-360-J2A engine is rated at what takeoff power, and how does it compare to the physical engine?
items.explanation: Section 1 DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Powerplant: the O-360-J2A is rated 145 BHP (derated) at 2700 RPM in the R22 Beta II. Maximum continuous rating in the R22 is 124 BHP at 2652 RPM (104% on the tachometer); the 5-minute takeoff rating for Beta and Beta II is 131 BHP at 2652 RPM.
references: R22 POH Sec 1: DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Powerplant (p.1-5)

items.question: What is the R22 maximum continuous power rating (as a tachometer percentage and BHP)?
items.explanation: Maximum continuous rating in the R22 is 124 BHP at 2652 RPM (104% on the tachometer). The 5-minute takeoff rating for the Beta and Beta II is 131 BHP at 2652 RPM.
references: R22 POH Sec 1: DESCRIPTIVE DATA – Powerplant (p.1-5)
